shots.visual: The Horizon Keeper stands on a narrow metal gantry above a vast abyss, holding a long pole with an enormous wet brush; golden paint drips from the bristles. A colossal orange glowing canvas hangs between brutalist towers.
The Keeper pulls a heavy iron lever. Rusted winches tighten steel cables and slowly raise the enormous stitched canvas between the towers.
The Keeper paints the dark fabric with broad rhythmic strokes of molten ochre and carmine, building an artificial fiery dawn.
Extreme close-up of brush bristles pressing thick golden-orange pigment into coarse linen fibers; the painted solar corona glows behind the texture.
Close portrait of the elderly Keeper inspecting the work; the artificial sunrise is reflected in worn brass goggles with amber lenses.
From behind, the Keeper steps back on the high gantry and looks at the immense painted sunrise suspended over the city.
shots.voiceover: Люди внизу открывают окна и верят, что новый день всегда наступает сам по себе.

shots.visual: A vertiginous top-down view of the monumental city far below; tiny windows open and catch the warm golden light from the artificial dawn.
shots.voiceover: Они не замечают грубых швов на ткани неба.

shots.visual: The camera moves around the canvas edge, revealing the contrast between its glowing painted front and its cold crude backside: stitches, ropes, rusted beams and icy rivets.
The camera passes behind the canvas. Its orange reverse side, seams and metal frame fill the foreground; beyond them lies dead cosmic emptiness, shattered atmospheric domes and crystalline ice dust.
A distant dead obsidian Sun split by fiery cracks hangs in the void. The tiny glowing orange canvas remains at the left, illuminating the city like the last surviving spark.
